title: every class with code in data_recorder reaches the diagnostic mixin
intention: Every class with code in data_recorder reaches DiagnosticBase: DataRecorder take it as their first base, so each can run a diagnostic report when we need it, and each behaves as before.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector filed inspector-new-finding-every-class-reaches-the-diagnostic-mixin naming DataRecorder in data_recorder. Akien, 2026-10-27 (ticket 339a45cee6a1): "any class with code it in should be able to run a diagnostic report when we need it".
how: Import DiagnosticBase from cairn.tools.base.diagnostic in cairn/tools/data_recorder/data_recorder.py and make it the first base of DataRecorder, keeping every other base. Prove it with cairn/tools/data_recorder/proofs/test_every_data_recorder_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py.

clauses.claim: the build inspector's every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin sieve returns [] for component data_recorder at cairn/tools/data_recorder
DataRecorder each subclass DiagnosticBase, keep their original base, and behave as before

the mixin makes the recorder no machine: records stay structured JSON rather than prose, a diagnostic the recorder emits writes nothing at its own address and enters none of its records, and the recorder reads none of its own diagnostics, so it gates no writes and acts on no feedback

decisions.text: D1: DiagnosticBase goes first among the bases, as 668c8d64b4e2 and b13c53dd679c did; the import sits at module level beside the others; nothing else in the class changes.
